attributes.action: Ban data centres and construction of data centres throughout the UK Indefinitely
attributes.additional_details: Water is essential to life. Bugs and wildlife are essential to the eco system and our food production. The decrease & destruction in wild/native areas has contributed to the climate crisis to consider taking more after the 4th heatwave is suicide for humanity. AI has taken people's jobs, created problematic society, created indecent & non consenual images of people & children. AI is taking our land and clean water. It must be stopped. AI IS NOT MORE IMPORTANT THAN HUMAN LIFE. ban and remove AI
attributes.background: Stop and ban the construction of data centres throughout the UK indefinitely. The money that is to fund this madness should be placed in the areas we need such as the NHS, job employment and the climate crisis to ensure a future for humanity. Noone needs AI. AI should not be funded by the government

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: 

Ban the construction of new AI data centres: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776517
